---
title: "Figures for MEE submission: Unsupervised source separation and clustering of soundscape recordings predicts avian richness in hyperdiverse systems"
---


Fig 2:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "[path to data.csv]"
output_dir <- "[output path for figures]"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# We are only using Unsupervised Clusters for this plot
er_col_cluster <- "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed"

# Initial scales needed to pull in the raw data
initial_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Site_Date", "Site")
# Scales used for final plotting
plot_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Macro (~1 Hour)")
base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

theme_mee <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM")) 

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, then filter and rename Site/Site_Date
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  # Apply filtering rules for the Macro panel
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Combine the remaining Site and Site_Date records into a single level
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro (~1 Hour)", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. PLOT PREPARATION
# ==========================================
cat("Preparing plot data...\n")

# Set seed for reproducible jittering
set.seed(42)

sub_df <- df_final %>%
  mutate(
    ER = !!sym(er_col_cluster),
    
    # Dynamic Alpha based on density
    Alpha_Val = case_when(
      Summary_Level %in% c("Macro (~1 Hour)", "15_Minute_Interval") ~ 0.6,
      Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval" ~ 0.2,
      TRUE ~ 0.05 # For 15_Second_Interval
    ),
    
    # Selective Jittering: Only scramble the coordinates for the dense 15s/1m scales
    plot_ER = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval"), 
                     jitter(ER, amount = 0.4), ER),
    plot_SR = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval"), 
                     jitter(SR, amount = 0.4), SR)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER))

# Lock in the factor order so the facets draw left-to-right
sub_df$Summary_Level <- factor(sub_df$Summary_Level, levels = plot_scales)

# Calculate Spearman's Rho and P-Values (Using True Data, not Jittered Data)
stats_df <- sub_df %>%
  group_by(Region, Summary_Level) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    df_sub <- .x
    if (nrow(df_sub) < 3) return(data.frame(rho = NA, pval = NA))
    
    ct <- cor.test(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    
    p_val <- ct$p.value
    p_str <- if (p_val < 0.001) "< 0.001" else sprintf("= %.3f", p_val)
    
    data.frame(
      rho = ct$estimate,
      pval = p_str
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(rho)) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("\u03c1 = %.3f (p %s)", rho, pval))

# Calculate mathematically consistent coordinates for the floating labels
label_coords <- sub_df %>%
  group_by(Summary_Level) %>%
  summarize(
    max_x = max(ER, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_y = max(SR, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  left_join(label_coords, by = "Summary_Level") %>%
  mutate(
    # Because limits start at 0, multiplying by a percentage guarantees perfect alignment
    plot_x = max_x * 0.03, # Exactly 3% from the left edge
    plot_y = ifelse(Region == "PER", max_y * 1.06, max_y * 1.04) # Exact vertical tiering
  )

# ==========================================
# 4. GENERATE AND EXPORT PLOT
# ==========================================
cat("Building 2x2 grid plot...\n")

p <- ggplot(sub_df) +
  
  # --- POINT LAYER 1: 15-Second Scale (All shapes) - Size 1.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 1.5) +
             
  # --- POINT LAYER 2a: 1-Minute Scale for non-triangle shapes - Size 1.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval" & Dataset != "STM_s_HTR"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 1.5) +
             
  # --- POINT LAYER 2b: 1-Minute Scale for STM_s_HTR (Triangles) - Size bumped to 2.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "1_Minute_Interval" & Dataset == "STM_s_HTR"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 2.5) +
             
  # --- POINT LAYER 3: 15-Minute Scale (Tripled Size) - Size 4.5 ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val), 
             size = 4.5) +
  
  # --- POINT LAYER 4: Macro Scales (Fixed Size 4.5 to match 15m scale) ---
  geom_point(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level == "Macro (~1 Hour)"),
             aes(x = plot_ER, y = plot_SR, color = Region, shape = Dataset, alpha = Alpha_Val),
             size = 6) +
  
  scale_alpha_identity() +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(name = "Region", values = c("PER" = "green4", "STM" = "darkorange2")) +
  
  # Shapes: PER is set to 16 but excluded via `breaks`, dropping it from the legend
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "STM sub-datasets", 
    values = c("PER" = 16, "STM_h" = 16, "STM_s_HTR" = 17, "STM_s_LTR" = 15),
    breaks = c("STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR") 
  ) +
  
  # TRENDLINE: Linear model for all Scales (Weights use True Effort_Minutes)
  geom_smooth(data = filter(sub_df, Summary_Level %in% plot_scales),
               aes(x = ER, y = SR, color = Region, weight = Effort_Minutes), 
               method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +
               
  # Floating Stats with White Outline
  geom_text_repel(data = stats_df, 
                  aes(x = plot_x, y = plot_y, label = label, color = Region), 
                  hjust = 0, vjust = 1, direction = "y", 
                  point.padding = NA, 
                  bg.color = "white", bg.r = 0.15, 
                  segment.color = NA, size = 4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Faceting: 2 columns x 2 rows creates exactly 4 panels
  facet_wrap(~ Summary_Level, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, scales = "free", 
             labeller = as_labeller(function(x) gsub("_", " ", x))) +
  
  # Force axes to start at (0,0) exactly
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + 
  
  labs(
    title = "Source-clustering and Species Richness: Predictive Performance by Region",
    x = "Estimated Richness (Source-clustering)",
    y = "Observed Richness (SR)"
  ) +
  theme_mee() +
  
  # Legend Customization and Horizontal Formatting
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 5, shape = 16, fill = NA), order = 1, nrow = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 4, color = "darkorange2"), order = 2, nrow = 1)
  )

output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "figure2_2.png")
ggsave(output_path, p, width = 10, height = 9, dpi = 300)
cat("Done! Saved plot to:", output_path, "\n")
```


fig 3: relative RMSE
 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "[path to data.csv]"
output_dir <- "[output path for figures]"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

target_scales <- c(
  "15_Second_Interval" = "15-Second Resolution",
  "1_Minute_Interval"  = "1-Minute Resolution",
  "15_Minute_Interval" = "15-Minute Resolution",
  "Macro"              = "Macro (~1 Hour) Resolution"
)

base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

# 30 Metrics (Source Separation excluded)
metrics_list <- c(
  "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed", "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_noise_removed", "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_all_channels",
  "hier_euc_t0.7_br_all_channels",
  "perchV2>.1_all", "perchV2>.1_region", "perchV2>.3_all", "perchV2>.3_region", 
  "perchV2>.5_all", "perchV2>.5_region", "perchV2>.7_all", "perchV2>.7_region", 
  "perchV2>.9_all", "perchV2>.9_region",
  "br_ACI", "br_BI", "br_surface_roughness", "br_spectral_snr", 
  "br_ACTspfract_avg", "br_EVNspCount_sum", "br_EVNspFract_avg", "br_ROIcover",
  "fr_ACI", "fr_BI", "fr_surface_roughness", "fr_spectral_snr", 
  "fr_ACTspfract_avg", "fr_EVNspCount_sum", "fr_EVNspFract_avg", "fr_ROIcover"
)

# Updated theme for facet_wrap with MUCH larger legends and clear headers
theme_mee_dotplot <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      
      # FACET HEADERS
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", color = "black", linewidth = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(t = 8, b = 8)),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      
      # MASSIVE LEGEND
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),       
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),                       
      legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.box.margin = margin(t = 20, b = 10),
      
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray85", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

clean_metric_name <- function(raw_name) {
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed") return("[BR, noise removed] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_noise_removed") return("[FR, noise removed] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_br_all_channels") return("[BR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering")
  if (raw_name == "hier_euc_t0.7_fr_all_channels") return("[FR, all channels] Hierarchical Clustering")
  
  if (grepl("perch", raw_name)) {
    clean <- gsub("perchV[12]>", "Perch (Conf > ", raw_name)
    clean <- gsub("_all", " All)", clean)
    clean <- gsub("_region", " Region)", clean)
    return(clean)
  }
  
  if (grepl("^br_", raw_name) || grepl("^fr_", raw_name)) {
    prefix <- ifelse(grepl("^br_", raw_name), "[BR] ", "[FR] ")
    core <- gsub("^[bf]r_", "", raw_name)
    core <- gsub("_avg", " (Avg)", core)
    core <- gsub("_sum", " (Sum)", core)
    core <- gsub("surface_roughness", "Surface Roughness", core)
    core <- gsub("spectral_snr", "Spectral SNR", core)
    return(paste0(prefix, core))
  }
  return(raw_name)
}

# ==========================================
# 2. LOAD DATA & SYNC MACRO LOGIC
# ==========================================
cat("Loading and processing master dataset...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
df <- df %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(metrics_list, colnames(df))), ~as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), ""))))

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_combined <- bind_rows(
  base_effort %>% group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>% summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date"),
  base_effort %>% group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>% summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")
)

df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro", Summary_Level))

# ==========================================
# 3. BOOTSTRAPPING TO A SINGLE DATAFRAME
# ==========================================
cat("Bootstrapping rRMSE for all scales...\n")
all_results_list <- list()
dynamic_scale_titles <- c() # To keep track of our new titles for factor ordering

for (scale in names(target_scales)) {
  base_scale_title <- target_scales[[scale]]
  df_sub <- df_final %>% filter(Summary_Level == scale)
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) next
  
  # Calculate mean SR formatted to exactly 1 decimal place
  mean_sr <- sprintf("%.1f", mean(df_sub$SR, na.rm = TRUE))
  scale_title <- sprintf("%s\n(Mean SR: %s)", base_scale_title, mean_sr)
  dynamic_scale_titles <- c(dynamic_scale_titles, scale_title)
  
  for (metric in metrics_list) {
    if (!metric %in% colnames(df_sub)) next
    
    df_mod <- df_sub %>% dplyr::select(SR, Metric_Val = all_of(metric), Effort_Minutes) %>% drop_na()
    if (nrow(df_mod) < 3) next
    
    boot_res <- replicate(500, {
      idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df_mod)), replace = TRUE)
      d <- df_mod[idx, ]
      mod <- lm(SR ~ Metric_Val, data = d, weights = Effort_Minutes)
      
      # 1. Absolute RMSE
      abs_rmse <- sqrt(sum(d$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(d$Effort_Minutes))
      
      # 2. Relative RMSE
      rel_rmse <- abs_rmse / mean(d$SR)
      
      rel_rmse
    })
    
    category <- "Traditional Acoustic Index"
    if (grepl("hier", metric)) category <- "Source-clustering"
    if (grepl("perch", metric)) category <- "Perch Classifier"
    
    all_results_list[[paste(scale, metric)]] <- data.frame(
      Scale_ID = scale,
      Scale_Title = scale_title,
      Raw_Name = metric, 
      Clean_Name = clean_metric_name(metric),
      Category = category, 
      Mean_rRMSE = mean(boot_res),
      Lower_CI = quantile(boot_res, 0.025),
      Upper_CI = quantile(boot_res, 0.975)
    )
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 4. DATA SORTING & PLOTTING (FACET_WRAP)
# ==========================================
legend_categories <- c("Perch Classifier", "Source-clustering", "Traditional Acoustic Index")

all_results_df <- bind_rows(all_results_list) %>%
  # 1. Lock in the order of the facets using our dynamically generated titles
  mutate(Scale_Title = factor(Scale_Title, levels = dynamic_scale_titles)) %>%
  
  # 2. Sort by rRMSE descending so the highest error is at the bottom
  arrange(Scale_Title, desc(Mean_rRMSE)) %>%
  
  # 3. Create a unique Y-axis label combining Name and Scale
  mutate(Plot_Label = factor(paste(Clean_Name, Scale_Title, sep = "___"), 
                             levels = unique(paste(Clean_Name, Scale_Title, sep = "___"))))

cat("Generating unified faceted plot...\n")

p <- ggplot(all_results_df, aes(x = Mean_rRMSE, y = Plot_Label, color = Category, shape = Category)) +
  # Increased line thickness and point size
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower_CI, xmax = Upper_CI), height = 0, linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 4.5) +
  
  # REVERSE THE X-AXIS
  scale_x_reverse() +
  
  # Use facet_wrap with free scales to allow the Y-axis to shift independently
  facet_wrap(~Scale_Title, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  
  # Strip out the hidden "___Scale" string so the labels look normal on the plot
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("___.*$", "", x)) +
  
  # Custom requested colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Perch Classifier" = "#CC79A7", 
               "Source-clustering" = "#0072B2", 
               "Traditional Acoustic Index" = "#E69F00"),
    limits = legend_categories
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Perch Classifier" = 16, 
               "Source-clustering" = 17, 
               "Traditional Acoustic Index" = 15),
    limits = legend_categories
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relative Root Mean Square Error (rRMSE) ± 95% CI\n(Numbers reversed so better predictions scale from left to right)", 
    y = NULL,
    color = "Methodology", shape = "Methodology"
  ) +
  theme_mee_dotplot() +
  
  # Override the legend aesthetics to make the lines and points massive in the legend box
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 8, linewidth = 2.5)))

# CHANGED: Updated filename to avoid overwriting the absolute RMSE plot
output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "Figure4_Combined_Resolutions_rRMSE_DotPlot_Faceted.png")
ggsave(output_path, p, width = 20, height = 22, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved Faceted Plot PNG to", output_path, "\n")

```

fig 4. with just perch 2.0 (for body text):
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "[path to data.csv]"
output_dir <- "[output path for figures]"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

er_col_cluster <- "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed"

# Initial scales needed to pull the raw data before merging
initial_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Site_Date", "Site")
# The actual 4 panels to loop through
plot_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Macro (~1 Hour)")

base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

# Elegant, High-IF Journal Theme
theme_mee <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, filter for the correct scopes, and re-combine into Macro
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro (~1 Hour)", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================
# 3. STATS FUNCTIONS (Effort-Weighted)
# ==========================================
get_r2 <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  val <- summary(mod)$adj.r.squared
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rho <- function(df_sub) {
  val <- cor(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rmse <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_rmse <- sqrt(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes))
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_rmse))
}

get_mae <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_mae <- sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * abs(residuals(mod))) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes)
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_mae))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. DYNAMIC PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ==========================================
create_model_comparison_plot <- function(scale_name, data, er_col_perchV2, perchV2_label, show_y_label = TRUE, show_x_label = TRUE) {
  
  # Create a named vector dynamically to properly map the selected variables in dplyr::select
  select_map <- c("SR", "Effort_Minutes", "Source-clustering" = er_col_cluster)
  select_map[perchV2_label] <- er_col_perchV2

  sub_df <- data %>% 
    filter(Summary_Level == scale_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(select_map)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(`Source-clustering`, all_of(perchV2_label)), 
                 names_to = "Model", values_to = "ER") %>%
    filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Factor the model column so it always plots as Clusters -> V2
      Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Source-clustering", perchV2_label))
    )
  
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  stats_df <- sub_df %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      df_sub <- .x
      if (nrow(df_sub) < 3) return(data.frame(ideal_slope = NA, r2 = NA, rho = NA, rmse = NA, mae = NA))
      
      max_x <- max(df_sub$ER, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_y <- max(df_sub$SR, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        r2 = get_r2(df_sub),
        rho = get_rho(df_sub),
        rmse = get_rmse(df_sub),
        mae = get_mae(df_sub),
        ideal_slope = max_y / max_x
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(r2)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r2, "\n\u03c1 = ", rho, "\nRMSE = ", rmse, "\nMAE = ", mae))
  
  is_dense <- scale_name %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval")
  is_macro <- scale_name == "Macro (~1 Hour)"
  
  pt_alpha <- ifelse(is_dense, 0.05, 0.6) 
  pt_size <- ifelse(is_macro, 6, ifelse(is_dense, 1, 2.5))
  
  plot_title <- gsub("_", " ", scale_name)
  y_axis_lab <- if(show_y_label) "Observed Richness (SR)" else NULL
  x_axis_lab <- if(show_x_label) "Estimated Richness (ER)" else NULL
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = ER, y = SR, color = Model)) +
    geom_point(alpha = pt_alpha, size = pt_size) +
    geom_abline(data = stats_df, aes(intercept = 0, slope = ideal_slope), 
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_smooth(aes(weight = Effort_Minutes), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_label(data = stats_df, 
               aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label, color = Model), 
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.1, 
               fill = "white", label.size = 0.5, label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
               size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # Switch to ncol = 2 to fit both models
    facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") + 
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(c("#3C5488", "#E64B35"), 
                        c("Source-clustering", perchV2_label)),
      labels = setNames(c("Source-clustering", "Perch v2.0"), 
                        c("Source-clustering", perchV2_label))
    ) +
    
    # Force axes to start at exactly 0 and use integer-only breaks
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA), 
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
      breaks = function(x) { b <- pretty(x); b[b %% 1 == 0] }
    ) + 
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA), 
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
      breaks = function(x) { b <- pretty(x); b[b %% 1 == 0] }
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = x_axis_lab,
      y = y_axis_lab
    ) +
    theme_mee() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 9, shape = 16, fill = NA)))
  
  return(p)
}

# ==========================================
# 5. BATCH GENERATE AND EXPORT
# ==========================================
cat("Starting batch plot generation...\n")

# Define the variable parameters
list_types <- c("region", "all")
thresholds <- c("0.1", "0.3", "0.5", "0.7", "0.9")

for (lt in list_types) {
  for (th in thresholds) {
    
    # Strip the leading 0 for file naming/column selection (e.g., "0.1" -> ".1")
    th_col_str <- sub("^0", "", th)
    
    # Dynamically build variables specific to this combination
    er_col_perchV2 <- paste0("perchV2>", th_col_str, "_", lt)
    
    list_label <- ifelse(lt == "region", "region list", "all species")
    perchV2_label <- paste0("Perch v2.0 conf >", th, " (", list_label, ")")
    
    cat(sprintf("\n--- Processing Threshold: %s | List: %s ---\n", th, lt))
    
    all_plots_model_split <- list()
    # Iterate using plot_scales so it loops over the 4 panels
    for (i in seq_along(plot_scales)) {
      scale <- plot_scales[i]
      is_last_row <- (i == length(plot_scales))
      cat("  > Generating:", scale, "\n")
      
      all_plots_model_split[[scale]] <- create_model_comparison_plot(
                                              scale_name = scale,
                                              data = df_final,
                                              er_col_perchV2 = er_col_perchV2,
                                              perchV2_label = perchV2_label,
                                              show_y_label = TRUE, 
                                              show_x_label = is_last_row)
    }
    
    valid_model_plots <- all_plots_model_split[!sapply(all_plots_model_split, is.null)]
    
    if (length(valid_model_plots) > 0) {
      cat("  > Assembling layout...\n")
      
      p_model_grid <- wrap_plots(valid_model_plots, ncol = 1, nrow = length(plot_scales)) +
        plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
      
      output_path <- paste0(output_dir, "SR_vs_ER_Combined_Only_Model_Split_", lt, "_", th_col_str, "_v2.png")
      
      # Height is set to 15 to fit the 4 rows
      ggsave(output_path, p_model_grid, width = 10, height = 15, dpi = 300) # Adjusted width slightly for 2 cols
      cat("  > Done! Saved to:", output_path, "\n")
    }
  }
}

cat("\nAll 10 combinations generated successfully!\n")
```

10 iterations of fig 4. with all perch settings, including both perch 1.0 and perch 2.0 (for supplementals)

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==========================================
input_file <- "[path to data.csv]"
output_dir <- "[output path for figures]"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

er_col_cluster <- "hier_euc_t0.7_br_noise_removed"

# Initial scales needed to pull the raw data before merging
initial_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Site_Date", "Site")
# The actual 4 panels to loop through
plot_scales <- c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval", "Macro (~1 Hour)")

base_datasets <- c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR", "STM_s_LTR")

# Elegant, High-IF Journal Theme
theme_mee <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREP & EFFORT CALCULATION
# ==========================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
df <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% base_datasets,
         Summary_Level %in% initial_scales) %>%
  mutate(Region = ifelse(grepl("PER", Dataset), "PER", "STM"))

base_effort <- df %>%
  filter(
    (Dataset %in% c("PER", "STM_h", "STM_s_HTR") & Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval") |
    (Dataset == "STM_s_LTR" & Summary_Level == "15_Minute_Interval")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Minute_Value = ifelse(Summary_Level == "15_Second_Interval", 0.25, 15),
    Target_Site_Date = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Grouping),
    Target_Site = sub("_[^_]+_[^_]+$", "", Grouping)
  )

effort_site_date <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site_Date) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site_Date")

effort_site <- base_effort %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Grouping = Target_Site) %>%
  summarize(Effort_Minutes = sum(Minute_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Summary_Level = "Site")

effort_combined <- bind_rows(effort_site_date, effort_site)

# Merge efforts, filter for the correct scopes, and re-combine into Macro
df_final <- df_filtered %>%
  left_join(effort_combined, by = c("Dataset", "Summary_Level", "Grouping")) %>%
  mutate(Effort_Minutes = replace_na(Effort_Minutes, 1)) %>%
  filter(
    Summary_Level %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval", "15_Minute_Interval") |
    (Region == "STM" & Summary_Level == "Site") |
    (Region == "PER" & Summary_Level == "Site_Date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Summary_Level = ifelse(Summary_Level %in% c("Site", "Site_Date"), "Macro (~1 Hour)", Summary_Level)
  )

# ==========================================

get_r2 <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)

  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rho <- function(df_sub) {
  val <- cor(df_sub$ER, df_sub$SR, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  return(sprintf("%.3f", val))
}

get_rmse <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_rmse <- sqrt(sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * residuals(mod)^2) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes))
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_rmse))
}

get_mae <- function(df_sub) {
  mod <- lm(SR ~ ER, data = df_sub, weights = Effort_Minutes)
  weighted_mae <- sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes * abs(residuals(mod))) / sum(df_sub$Effort_Minutes)
  return(sprintf("%.3f", weighted_mae))
}

# ==========================================
# 4. DYNAMIC PLOTTING FUNCTION
# ==========================================
create_model_comparison_plot <- function(scale_name, data, er_col_perchV1, er_col_perchV2, perchV1_label, perchV2_label, show_y_label = TRUE, show_x_label = TRUE) {
  
  # Create a named vector dynamically to properly map the selected variables in dplyr::select
  select_map <- c("SR", "Effort_Minutes", "Source-clustering" = er_col_cluster)

  sub_df <- data %>% 
    filter(Summary_Level == scale_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(select_map)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(`Source-clustering`, all_of(perchV1_label), all_of(perchV2_label)), 
                 names_to = "Model", values_to = "ER") %>%
    filter(!is.na(SR) & !is.na(ER)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Factor the model column so it always plots as Clusters -> V1 -> V2
      Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Source-clustering", perchV1_label, perchV2_label))
    )
  
  if(nrow(sub_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  stats_df <- sub_df %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      df_sub <- .x
      if (nrow(df_sub) < 3) return(data.frame(ideal_slope = NA, r2 = NA, rho = NA, rmse = NA, mae = NA))
      
      max_x <- max(df_sub$ER, na.rm = TRUE)
      max_y <- max(df_sub$SR, na.rm = TRUE)
      
      data.frame(
        r2 = get_r2(df_sub),
        rho = get_rho(df_sub),
        rmse = get_rmse(df_sub),
        mae = get_mae(df_sub),
        ideal_slope = max_y / max_x
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(r2)) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r2, "\n\u03c1 = ", rho, "\nRMSE = ", rmse, "\nMAE = ", mae))
  
  is_dense <- scale_name %in% c("15_Second_Interval", "1_Minute_Interval")
  is_macro <- scale_name == "Macro (~1 Hour)"
  
  pt_alpha <- ifelse(is_dense, 0.05, 0.6) 
  pt_size <- ifelse(is_macro, 6, ifelse(is_dense, 1, 2.5))
  
  plot_title <- gsub("_", " ", scale_name)
  y_axis_lab <- if(show_y_label) "Observed Richness (SR)" else NULL
  x_axis_lab <- if(show_x_label) "Estimated Richness (ER)" else NULL
  
  p <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = ER, y = SR, color = Model)) +
    geom_point(alpha = pt_alpha, size = pt_size) +
    geom_abline(data = stats_df, aes(intercept = 0, slope = ideal_slope), 
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_smooth(aes(weight = Effort_Minutes), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_label(data = stats_df, 
               aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = label, color = Model), 
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.1, 
               fill = "white", label.size = 0.5, label.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
               size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # Switch to ncol = 3 to fit all three models
    facet_wrap(~ Model, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") + 
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(c("#3C5488", "#00A087", "#E64B35"), 
                        c("Source-clustering", perchV1_label, perchV2_label)),
      labels = setNames(c("Source-clustering", "Perch v1.0", "Perch v2.0"), 
                        c("Source-clustering", perchV1_label, perchV2_label))
    ) +
    
    # Force axes to start at exactly 0 and use integer-only breaks
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),

      limits = c(0, NA),

    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = plot_title,

      y = y_axis_lab
    ) +
    theme_mee() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 9, shape = 16, fill = NA)))
  
  return(p)
}
```
